programs.description: Franco, who runs an automobile workshop, and his sister Jenny, a college student, share a very strong bond. Matters take a turn when Franco falls in love with Jenny's enemy.
After being forsaken by his mother in a temple, Aravindan, a five-year-old boy, is taken in by a hotelier. Against all odds, Aravindan clings to the hope of reuniting with his mother.
Georgekutty asks Kutty to build houses for him, but a debt-ridden Kutty rents out the houses instead of building them. Trouble ensues after Georgekutty finds out and throws out the tenants.
Stephen, a quadriplegic, befriends John, a musician, and they develop a good rapport. However, their friendship is put to the test when Anjali enters their lives.
The Kauravas and Pandavas, two rival families, battle for supremacy in Hastinapur. With Krishna's support, the Pandavas strive to emerge victorious.
Kochubaby and Mary, a visually impaired duo, fall in love and get married. Unfortunately, she dies in an accident, and he struggles to look after their only daughter.
Mahadevan, a policeman, goes to a village to find the criminals behind a bomb blast. He is determined to unravel the mystery behind the tragedy and gets help from a crazy bunch of local policemen.
Bhargavan, a criminal suffering from panic attacks that hold him back from attacking people, goes to a psychiatrist for treatment.
Kunjava and his mate welcome a tail-wagging friend called Neymar, only to find their lives thrown into complete disarray.
Nityananda Shenoy, a gangster from Kasaragod, decides to exact revenge on an ex-minister who swindled him right before demonetisation. Meanwhile, Muthuvel and his mother struggle to survive in Kochi.
Anandan, a doctor, develops feelings for a girl in his neighbourhood. However, after realising that she is in financial trouble, he helps her repay her debts.
Rishi is a diligent collector who works honestly for the good of people. However, things take a turn after he draws the attention of corrupt politicians and businessmen who want to cause trouble.
Kavitha, a struggling woman, goes through a difficult time while repaying her brother's debts. Later, she takes up an acting job for a commercial and things change drastically.

Kannan and Radha share a deep romantic bond that transcends eras and emotions. However, they must navigate various obstacles together as their timeless affection continues to grow.

Building contractor Nambiar learns that his spate of bad luck is due to a statue kept at home. He succeeds in transferring his misfortune to his rival, but the statue finds its way back into his life.

Vidyalakshmi struggles to lead a normal life with her daughter after the sudden death of her husband. However, her world transforms after meeting Preman, an auto-rickshaw driver.
An anthology of three stories. The first story involves a murder investigation, the second story is about a group of goons following a girl, the third involves five friends delivering a package.
When a family of four sets out on a road trip, they are accompanied by two girls on their way. However, things take an unexpected turn when one of the girls is found dead.
After an elephant saves him from an accident in childhood, Krishna becomes fond of elephants. His life changes when he decides to adopt Arjunan, a severely injured elephant.
